svg.title: Fogcast residual blocks: channel projection and pooled downsampling
svg.desc: Two complete residual blocks complement the Model A residual U-Net architecture. Each main path has a 3 by 3 convolution, GroupNorm with 8 groups, SiLU, a second 3 by 3 convolution and GroupNorm. Add the shortcut, then apply SiLU. In the channel-projection block all strides are 1; the shortcut has a 1 by 1 convolution then GroupNorm, preserving spatial dimensions. In the pooled-downsampling block the first main convolution has stride 2; the shortcut has 2 by 2 average pooling at stride 2 with ceil_mode=True, a 1 by 1 convolution at stride 1 and GroupNorm. Both output spatial dimensions are the ceiling of half their input dimensions. Spatial dimensions are H and W with in/out subscripts. All block convolutions have no bias; 3 by 3 convolutions use padding 1. GroupNorm has epsilon 1e-5 and affine parameters.
svg.text: Model A · channel projection and pooled downsampling · complete main and shortcut paths
Stride 1 · Encoder 0, fusion and all decoders
All block convolutions: no bias. 3×3 convolutions: padding 1. GroupNorm: 8 groups, ε = 10⁻⁵, learned scale and offset.
SiLU(z) = z · sigmoid(z). Both paths have matching output shapes. U-Net skip concatenation occurs before each decoder block.
Source: fogcast/residual_unet_fogcast/model.py · ResidualBlock2d · pooled mode selected by the temporal Model A preset
